mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_inventory (user_id, item_id, acquired_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{itemId}, now()) ON CONFLICT (user_id, item_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT i.item_id, i.category, i.name, i.description, i.price, i.status, i.reject_reason, i.sales_count, i.creator_id, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM user_inventory ui JOIN item i ON ui.item_id = i.item_id WHERE ui.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ui.acquired_at DESC
